source: OSHB morphology + Strong's (prisma/dev.db); patterns per Gesenius' Hebrew Grammar §84–86
scope: Nouns that noun-patterns.json leaves without a mishkal, and all adjectives. Only words that got a mishkal are listed.

statuses.classified: Root from Strong's, skeleton matches a Gesenius pattern directly (incl. weak roots that keep all root letters)
statuses.weak-root: Root from Strong's is weak; skeleton matches a weak-root rule based on Gesenius' examples (see `basis`)
statuses.ambiguous-root-agreeing: Strong's gives several roots; all that fit give the same mishkal
statuses.inferred-root: No root in Strong's; every Hebrew verb root that fits (at most 3, listed in rootCandidates) gives the same mishkal
